propositions: Pass-1 finders flag plan-vs-code discrepancies during execution-phase re-review that are expected results of the plan's directed work being completed (false positives blocking ticket closure).
A new na-default binary sub-answer `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal` is added to the plan-review verification model to enable veto decisions based on present-state code checks.
Pass-2 veto drops findings with `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal=yes` only when `execution_review=True` AND the finding criteria are in `registry.CODEBASE_GROUNDED` cohort.

The veto is cohort-restricted to CODEBASE_GROUNDED via `_restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded` in orchestrator, forcing non-grounded findings to `na` and preventing single-turn tool-less verifiers from firing the veto.
Planning-phase reviews and code-review calls remain unaffected; `execution_review` kwarg defaults to False.
The `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal` field is plan-review-only, not in `GRADED_BINARY`, and absent from base and code-review models.
